description: autobrr: IRC status, announces by network, and releases matched, grabbed and rejected. The collapsed rows hold network outages, runtime and setup.

panels.title: IRC
panels.description: Whether every enabled IRC network is connected and monitoring its announce channels.

panels.title: Last announce
panels.description: Time since the newest announce on any IRC channel. A long gap means announces aren't arriving.

panels.title: Releases
panels.description: Releases that matched a filter in the selected range.

panels.title: Grabbed
panels.description: Pushes approved in the selected range: the arr or download client took the release.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Pushes that failed with an error in the selected range. Should be 0.

panels.title: Grab rate
panels.description: Share of pushes grabbed in the selected range. Arrs reject releases they already have or don't want.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time((clamp_min(max by (job) (autobrr_release_push_approved_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) - max by (job) (autobrr_release_push_approved_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} offset 1m), 0))[$__range:1m])) / ((sum(sum_over_time((clamp_min(max by (job) (autobrr_release_push_approved_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) - max by (job) (autobrr_release_push_approved_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} offset 1m), 0))[$__range:1m])) + sum(sum_over_time((clamp_min(max by (job) (autobrr_release_push_rejected_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) - max by (job) (autobrr_release_push_rejected_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} offset 1m), 0))[$__range:1m])) + sum(sum_over_time((clamp_min(max by (job) (autobrr_release_push_error_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) - max by (job) (autobrr_release_push_error_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} offset 1m), 0))[$__range:1m]))) > 0)

panels.title: Pushes per hour
panels.description: Pushes each hour by outcome: grabbed, rejected by the arr or the action's checks, or failed with an error.

panels.title: Grabs per day
panels.description: Releases grabbed each day, last 14 days.

panels.title: Announce activity by network per hour
panels.description: Minutes each hour with a new announce, by IRC network; brighter is busier.

targets.expr: sum by (network) (sum_over_time((max by (job, network) (autobrr_irc_channel_last_announced_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",network=~"$network"}) > bool max by (job, network) (autobrr_irc_channel_last_announced_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",network=~"$network"} offset 1m))[$__interval:1m])) or (sum by (network) (max by (job, network) (autobrr_irc_channel_enabled_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",network=~"$network"})) > 0) * 0

panels.title: Last announce by network
panels.description: Time since each IRC network's last announce, stalest first. Networks silent since autobrr started show its uptime.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, time() - max by (network) (autobrr_irc_channel_last_announced_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",network=~"$network"}) or (sum by (network) (max by (job, network) (autobrr_irc_channel_enabled_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",network=~"$network"})) > 0) * 0 + scalar(time() - max(process_start_time_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}))))

panels.title: Networks down
panels.description: Enabled IRC networks that were disconnected or not monitoring their announce channels.

panels.title: Downtime by network
panels.description: Time in the selected range with an enabled announce channel not monitored, by IRC network.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, 60 * sum by (network) (sum_over_time((sum by (network) (max by (job, network) (autobrr_irc_channel_enabled_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",network=~"$network"})) - sum by (network) (max by (job, network) (autobrr_irc_channel_monitored_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",network=~"$network"})) > bool 0)[$__range:1m])) > 0))

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU used by autobrr, as a share of one core.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Goroutines running. Steady growth with steady announces points to a leak.

panels.title: Setup
panels.description: Running version, time since start, and enabled filters, IRC networks, feeds and lists.

panels.title: Last run by feed
panels.description: Time since each RSS, Torznab or Newznab feed last ran, stalest first.

panels.title: Last refresh by list
panels.description: Time since each list last refreshed its filters, stalest first.
